svg.title: Lord of Victory: Six of Wands · Jupiter in Leo · Tiphareth (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Jupiter above the painting and Leo below, as Book T places them: "Above and below are short wands with flames issuing, surmounted respectively by the symbols of Jupiter and Leo, representing the Decan." The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1793138231725-rp5nzq0letq.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
